versions.changelog:
- No changes detected in this version; content remains unchanged from the previous release.
- No new features, bug fixes, or documentation updates were introduced.

Initial release of jwt-debugger: decode, validate, and debug JSON Web Tokens locally.

- Inspect JWT headers, payloads, and claims without external tools
- Validate signatures for HS256/RS256 using secrets or public keys
- Diagnose common authentication and JWT issues (expiration, claim problems, signature mismatches)
- Compare two tokens to identify differences
- Generate test JWTs for development and troubleshooting
